scope: Prevent a live-but-wrong relay port from being treated as the image service.

candidateSources: explicit Premium relay URL and URL list
implementation.probeContract: Each image candidate must pass bounded health and image-availability reads before selection.
implementation.selection: Availability-aware scoring prefers a confirmed ready candidate, then an image-compatible unknown candidate, and only then a compatible unavailable candidate.
implementation.resilience: The selected endpoint is cached briefly; repeated dispatch failures open a per-endpoint cooldown circuit; the next explicit attempt re-discovers candidates.
implementation.replaySafety: Generation POSTs are never automatically replayed on another endpoint after dispatch could have started.

verification.currentLocalResolution: Selected the functioning Premium image endpoint automatically; capability remained unknown.

next_step: Keep both Star cohorts inactive. Require positive capability evidence and separate bounded authorization before any future generation qualification.
